name: Self Sacrifice
overview: Scripture reveals that true life is found through self-sacrifice, as Jesus teaches that those who lose their lives for His sake will ultimately find them (Matthew 10:39; John 12:25). The greatest expression of love is exemplified in laying down one's life for others, reflecting Christ’s own sacrificial gift (John 15:13; John 3:16). Believers are called to offer themselves as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, demonstrating humility and valuing others above themselves as a practical outworking of this selfless devotion (Romans 12:1; Philippians 2:3).
